episodes.story: Nahay Khay. Sonu (pre-board test in 5 days) adds Chhath to his Zeta plan -> 30 min/day; Maa: 'roz thoda, par roz'. Papa standing in a train from Delhi. Cliffhanger: Papa's phone off at midnight.

Kharna. Call log 'Papa · Switched off' x7. Maa's 36-hr nirjala fast begins; Sonu's 30-min mission with Zeta Flash Cards (Light formulas); gur ki kheer on the chulha. Ends: unknown call, train noise, faint 'Sonu...'.
Sandhya Arghya. Patna Jn board: Papa's train DELAYED 4H, one hour to arghya. Sonu carries the daura in Papa's place.

episodes.hook: one diya drifts into camera across a river of diyas
episodes.zeta: Revision notes: Light, one page of formulas
episodes.story: Usha Arghya finale. 4 AM, Papa's place empty. Sonu reassures Gudiya; Maa 36 hrs in the water; Sonu does his 30-min mission with Zeta Light revision notes (test in 3 days). Papa runs down the steps before sunrise, family offers arghya together, fast ends; Maa: 'roz thoda, par roz, Chhath ho ya padhai'. Teaser: Sonu ke Boards from 17 Nov. Offer: 40% CHHATH, comment NOTES.

episodes.hook: gust blows notebook pages across the courtyard at camera, TEST: 2 DIN
episodes.story: Papa back to Delhi ('number ki chinta mat kar, bas roz baith'). Test in 2 days: half the Science pages missing, Gudiya drew an elephant named Carbon over the Carbon notes. Maa: 'roz thoda, par roz'. Zeta Carbon revision notes; tip: each topic = 1 line + 1 example; covalent = sharing electrons like sharing one blanket ('kambal meri hai!'). Whole chapter in 2 pages in 1 hour, Gudiya's star. Cliffhanger: girl on the next roof with 7-colour notes (Pinky, Ep 2).

episodes.hook: 7 rainbow highlighter strokes slash the screen, Pinky revealed: TOPPER PADOS MEIN
episodes.zeta: Mnemonic Generator: Meth-Eth-Prop-But = Meri Ek Pyaari Behen
episodes.story: Test-eve. Pinky (topper next door) arrives: her Carbon notes are 40 pages in 7 colours vs Sonu's 2. Gudiya starts a mukabla: name 1-4 carbon compounds in order; Sonu blanks. Night: Zeta Mnemonic Generator -> 'Meri Ek Pyaari Behen' (Gudiya: 'main hi toh hoon!'). Tip: turn what won't stick into a small story. Morning: Sonu rattles it off, Sonu 1 · Pinky 0. Pinky: 'asli test aaj hai, 2 page vs 40'. Offer 40% CHHATH, comment NOTES.

episodes.hook: question paper slams onto the desk at camera, TEST DAY + 40 PAGE vs 2 PAGE
episodes.zeta: Revision notes: Carbon, 10-min last look in the auto
episodes.story: Test day. In the shared auto Pinky flips 40 pages; Sonu does a 10-min last look at Zeta Carbon revision notes; Gudiya: 'Meri Ek Pyaari Behen yaad hai?'. Exam tip: read the whole paper, known questions first, hard ones last. Q5 butane formula -> C4H10. Sonu attempts every question. Papa video call: 'mujhe number nahi, yahi chahiye tha'. Cliffhanger: Pinky alone on the school steps, left 3 questions blank. Offer 40% CHHATH, comment NOTES.

episodes.hook: a teardrop falls on Pinky's 7-colour notes page and the ink blooms: TOPPER KO BHI DARR LAGTA HAI
episodes.zeta: Photo of notes pages -> short notes (2 page) + quiz
episodes.story: After the test, Pinky on the school steps: 'sab yaad tha, par paper dekha toh dimaag khaali, haath kaanpne lage'. Sonu says nothing, shares half his tiffin roti. Evening in Sonu's courtyard, Gudiya is quiz master: 'kitaab band, jo yaad hai bolo'. Tip: after reading, close the book and write 3 things from memory. Sonu photographs Pinky's pages, Zeta makes short notes + a quiz; Pinky's hands shake but 9/10 ('Topper wapas aa gayi!'). Cliffhanger: Masterji debuts: 'kal se meri tuition, sirf ek seat khaali hai, tum dono mein se ek'. Offer 40% CHHATH, comment NOTES.

episodes.hook: water pours into a steel glass and the coin at the bottom appears to rise: SIKKA KHUD UPAR?
episodes.story: Next morning, Masterji's one-seat challenge: explain why a coin looks raised in water, no ratta. Pinky gives the perfect definition (refraction) but can't say why. Sonu remembers running the same experiment in Zeta Labs last night, pours water live: light bends leaving water, the eye assumes a straight line, so the coin looks higher. Tip: definition + one small experiment you do yourself. Masterji gives Sonu the seat; Sonu proposes half-half with Pinky ('jo padhe, wo doosre ko padhaye'); Masterji smiles for the first time. Cliffhanger: Gudiya runs in - test result tomorrow morning on the notice board. Offer 40% CHHATH, comment NOTES.
